9) specific_correction — four evidence-grounded contradictions in the prior corrected report, corrected here.
(9a) The prior report claimed the third attempt's "only factual defect was the geometry misattribution". That overstates completeness. The same prior report's OBSERVATIONS also called a terminal .05-vs-.075 comparison "between the 0.09/0.05 samples". Corrected: the prior report carried at least two factual defects — the geometry misattribution (a8382f8a) and this pair-mislabel — and the "only defect" characterisation is withdrawn.
(9b) The prior report stated the compact-summary omission of structure identities "is the mechanism by which §3 arose". Corrected: both the omission (sent_summary_omitted_structure = true) and the misattribution are recorded observations, but their coexistence does not identify the model's internal cause; no causal mechanism is asserted.
(9c) The prior report stated "real_time_demonstrated = false throughout; deadline_misses = 35 with control_period_s = 0.01 against mean_complete_update_s ≈ 8.3–9.2 s". Corrected: real_time_demonstrated = false and deadline_misses = 35 hold in every execution, but the mean-update range must be bound to a structure. On the shortened structure mean_complete_update_s ≈ 8.34–9.21 s; on the original structure ≈ 16.88–17.78 s. The 8.3–9.2 s range is not valid across both structures and is here bound to the shortened structure only.
(9d) The prior report's recommendation reproduced the frozen predecessor instruction "the next scope is independent M5 development" as current chronology. Corrected: that is a frozen predecessor instruction, not current chronology; the M5 matched development present in the protected records is already stopped at its own checkpoint, and this post-run reporting grant cannot change that scope or authorise further work. No new work is recommended.

10) SCOPE LIMITS. real_time_demonstrated = false in every execution; deadline_misses = 35 with control_period_s = 0.01, against mean_complete_update_s ≈ 8.34–9.21 s (shortened structure) and ≈ 16.88–17.78 s (original structure); coverage.continuous_time_guarantee = false; holding metrics are retained-sample aggregates over the final 0.05 s and terminal error is the last execution sample.
